limitations: The free-agent class, UFA/RFA, option flags, age and per-game figures are NBA.com's tracker as observed. NBA.com records each move once and does not revisit it.

Current status and team apply Wikipedia's dated moves (signings, two-way deals, waivers, camp cuts, signings abroad, retirements) after NBA.com's tracker, then the newest roster source (ESPN's 30 team rosters every 6 hours, or else the NBA player index): the roster decides who is on a team unless Wikipedia's move is dated the same day or later. NBA.com's own status stays beside the current one.
Wikipedia gives no dates for training-camp cuts; a cut is placed after the player's last signing with that team. Players whose name matches more than one Wikipedia entry keep NBA.com's status.
Deal terms are not on the source and stay unknown; they are never zero.
Per-game points, rebounds and assists are NBA.com's prior-season figures on the tracker.
Returned means the same team before and after (re-signed or option exercised); Signed means a different team.
Retired means NBA.com's note or Wikipedia's retirement list says so; retired players are left out of the tracked counts.
